_meta.description: Figma frames-mode eval: given a real Figma file's designs as candidates, does the scorer find the right design for a need, or say nothing fits? Source: the public Figma Community file '30+ Chart UI Components | BRIX Templates' (file key TkX9ifsyzkjZtIY0Lkzj3K), registered with figma_mode 'frames', figma_pages ['Design'] (43 candidates). The file itself is NOT committed (third-party content, 5 MB): fetch it with figma_file_key + FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN or save GET /v1/files/<key> and point FIGMA_EVAL_JSON at it.
_meta.labeling: Gold labels authored by Claude by LOOKING at PNG renders of the four category frames and matching each card to its candidate via the text inside it -- not verified by a human. 'gold' lists every candidate a reasonable designer would accept; empty gold = nothing in the file should match (checked by eye across all four sheets).
_meta.known_quirks: The file misspells one layer ('Pie Charts > Chat 2' is the credit-score gauge). 'Dashboard' groups in each category are page-shell distractors.
